# Copilot Instructions

## UI standards
- All UI elements in this project must use shadcn/ui components.
- Do not create custom UI components for app interfaces.
- Prefer existing shadcn/ui primitives and reuse them before introducing anything new.
- Use Tailwind utility classes consistently with shadcn/ui patterns.

## Project convention
- When implementing any UI, check the existing shadcn-based components in the project first.
- If a needed component is missing, add it through the shadcn/ui pattern rather than building a custom component from scratch.
